fact: A World Bank mission of 8-12 September 2025 records that consultants assessed the government data centre and offered a new Tier III build (EUR 4.6 million) among the options, recommended migrating government systems to a new data centre or cloud because of high risks at the present site, and the mission discussed a Disaster Recovery Plan.
title: Projecto São Tomé e Príncipe Digital (P177158) - Missão de Apoio a Implementação - Ajuda Memória
